title: 长安刮痕 EP01 18-shot motion redesign

rain.applies: continuous whenever L1 straight-lattice windows, west doorway, or L2 exterior are visible
rain.prohibited: random direction or intensity changes between shots

coldWind.source: Pei Yun opening L1 west door

timeline.EP01_SH08: first off-screen door crack; short leading gust reaches hero flame
timeline.EP01_SH09: gust continues at reduced strength as Shen reacts
timeline.EP01_SH10: door movement is revealed; pressure front enters room

windLinkedObjects.paperA: near loose sheet: lift in SH11, one page-turn in SH12, oscillate in SH13, settle in SH14
windLinkedObjects.paperB: secondary corner: brief lift only, never leaves desk
windLinkedObjects.heroFlame: leans east with the same gust; no independent direction change
windLinkedObjects.wardrobe: Pei robe hem and Shen sleeve respond to the same west-to-east force

characterLocks.ShenZhiwei: young Chinese woman; exact lock-v3 face; black futou; teal-blue official robe; black belt and boots
characterLocks.PeiYun: elderly Chinese man; exact lock-v2 face and gray beard; black futou; deep-crimson official robe; black belt and boots

propLocks.heroLamp: bronze proofreading oil lamp; never substitute a paper lantern
propLocks.openingLamp: the same bronze proofreading lamp carried by Shen; not the EP02 lantern-bearer's paper lantern
propLocks.residualScroll: warm fibrous paper with pressure relief; no model-generated readable glyph

prohibited: camera-only motion when an actor is visible

shots.purpose: Open on spatial movement and establish the dynamic baseline.
shots.startState: Shen enters the near end of L2 as a back/three-quarter silhouette, bronze proofreading lamp in hand, before her first visible step.
shots.performance: Walk two measured steps down the rain corridor; lamp hand swings slightly; robe hem trails.

camera.framing: full-body silhouette with deep corridor vanishing point
camera.primaryMove: side-track 0.8 m parallel to Shen, maintaining foreground-pillar parallax
camera.focus: hold Shen silhouette and near rain edge; no rack
camera.endCondition: Shen clears the first pillar; do not reveal an identifiable face

shots.environment: Diagonal rain, eave runoff, puddle ripples and wet reflections move continuously; compact lamp flame and robe respond to walking air.

shots.purpose: Turn the residual scroll into an active discovery surface.
shots.startState: Pressure field is almost dark; bright side-light is just outside frame right.
shots.performance: No actor visible; light sweeps across fibers and faint pressure traces emerge.

camera.primaryMove: 12 cm slider right-to-left along the paper ridge
camera.focus: 4 cm rack from near fiber ridge to pressure field
camera.endCondition: traces are visible but remain unreadable

shots.environment: Dust motes cross the light cone; no wind-driven paper motion yet.

shots.purpose: Motivate the changing side-light through a physical action.
shots.startState: Shen's hand hovers beside the lamp pedestal before contact; side-light is fixed.
shots.performance: Fingers contact and rotate the bronze base a small amount; the light pool sweeps onto pressure traces.

camera.focus: rack fingertips to newly lit paper texture
camera.endCondition: lamp rotation stops cleanly; traces remain unreadable

shots.environment: Flame bends briefly with lamp rotation then stabilizes; paper remains still.

shots.purpose: Add a precise forensic action beat.
shots.startState: Tweezers hover 2 cm above one fiber and have not touched the scroll.
shots.performance: Tweezers lower once and stop immediately above the selected fiber; no pluck.

camera.framing: extreme macro of tweezers tip and pressure field
camera.focus: tip-to-fiber rack ending on the selected fiber
camera.endCondition: tool and camera both settle without contact

shots.environment: Only dust and flame-light shimmer; no paper displacement.

shots.purpose: Replace a static portrait with active inspection.
shots.startState: Shen sits upright with both hands near the scroll before leaning.
shots.performance: She leans forward decisively by 8-10 cm, shoulders and gaze arriving together over the trace.

camera.framing: three-quarter medium-wide at the primary desk
camera.primaryMove: 7% dolly push with foreground lamp and shelf parallax
camera.focus: hold Shen's face through the lean
camera.endCondition: lean completes; no frozen breathing-only beat

shots.environment: Rain runs continuously beyond the lattice windows; lamp reflections tremble subtly on paper.

shots.purpose: Make the deduction readable through eye and brow motion.
shots.startState: Brow neutral, gaze at the near edge of the scroll.
shots.performance: Eyes track once across the pressure field; brow tightens and chin settles 1-2 cm.

camera.focus: rack from near paper edge to Shen's eyes
camera.endCondition: eyes stop on the inferred mark

shots.environment: Rain-window bokeh travels behind her; wardrobe remains calm.

shots.purpose: Give the lamp adjustment a second, wider spatial beat.
shots.startState: Left hand is open beside the lamp base; upper body remains behind it.
shots.performance: Hand grips and finishes a short base rotation, then releases; sleeve follows through.

camera.framing: low three-quarter hand, lamp and soft face layer
camera.focus: hold the hand/lamp plane; face remains softly readable
camera.endCondition: hand releases and light angle locks

shots.environment: Light pool crosses paper; rain remains visible at far window; no independent wind.

shots.purpose: Introduce the west-door pressure event before revealing its source.
shots.startState: Hero flame is upright and compact immediately before the off-screen door cracks.
shots.performance: Flame stretches and leans east once, then shivers at reduced height.

camera.focus: short rack from wick to flame tip
camera.endCondition: flame remains lit and points east

shots.environment: First west-to-east cold gust is caused only by Pei opening the off-screen west door; rain continues outside.

shots.purpose: Convert the gust into Shen's motivated reaction.
shots.startState: Shen still looks down; head and eyes have not turned.
shots.performance: She lifts her head, turns toward the west door and lets her gaze arrive after the head turn; sleeve edge reacts to the gust.

camera.endCondition: head and gaze lock toward west

shots.environment: Rain stays active; flame and sleeve retain the same west-to-east force direction.

shots.purpose: Reveal the room geography and west-door source.
shots.startState: Wide L1 axis with west door closed, Shen small at desk and foreground lamp dominant.
shots.performance: West door begins opening into the room while Shen remains turned toward it; no entrant visible yet.

camera.framing: wide room axis from foreground lamp to west door
camera.primaryMove: 0.5 m dolly pullback revealing the north blank rack area and west door
camera.endCondition: door gap established, Pei not yet revealed

shots.environment: Rain crosses every visible lattice bay; a pressure wave travels from west doorway toward papers and lamps.

shots.purpose: Break the entrance into a forceful threshold action.
shots.startState: Pei's leading boot hovers outside the sill; robe hem remains behind it.
shots.performance: Boot crosses and plants once; crimson robe hem follows through the doorway.

camera.primaryMove: camera backs 0.3 m as the boot advances
camera.endCondition: one foot planted inside; no second step

shots.environment: West-to-east gust strengthens: paperA lifts, paperB corner lifts, scroll edge ripples, flame leans east.

shots.purpose: Complete Pei's entrance with body and environment motion.
shots.startState: Pei is framed in the doorway before his full step and robe swing.
shots.performance: He takes one deliberate step into L1 and stops; robe swings with the step and head turns to scan the hall.

camera.primaryMove: 0.45 m lateral follow across the threshold
camera.endCondition: body stops inside; head finishes its scan

shots.environment: Peak gust turns paperA exactly one page, paperB flexes without leaving desk, flame and robe swing east.

shots.purpose: Hold tension without static posing or dialogue.
shots.startState: Pei has stopped; right hand is modestly raised at lower chest, mouth closed.
shots.performance: Right hand lowers out of frame, chest takes one restrained inhale and eyes scan once; no dialogue.

camera.framing: medium close three-quarter just inside doorway
camera.endCondition: camera and Pei stop for final 8 frames

shots.environment: Gust decays; paperA oscillates once, paperB drops, rain continues.

shots.startState: Over Pei's shoulder, Shen holds a neutral gaze before a tiny tightening reaction.
shots.performance: Shen's eyes narrow slightly and chin rises 1 cm; hands remain controlled; no dialogue.

camera.framing: Pei-shoulder foreground to Shen medium reaction
camera.focus: hold Shen; Pei shoulder remains soft foreground
camera.endCondition: reaction lands without a head turn

shots.environment: PaperA finishes settling, flame recovers toward vertical, rain never stops.

shots.purpose: Begin the deterministic reveal of 贞 without asking the video model to draw text.
shots.startState: Clean pressure field with no readable glyph in the I2V base plate.
shots.performance: Underlying fibers and raking light move subtly; deterministic overlay reveals the first strokes along the camera path.

camera.primaryMove: 10 cm overhead slide following the stroke direction
camera.endCondition: first deterministic strokes visible; base plate itself remains text-free

shots.environment: No new wind; tiny fibers and light shimmer only.

shots.purpose: Complete the glyph and let the camera settle on the evidence.
shots.startState: Clean stable base plate; editorial composite carries forward SH15's partial deterministic overlay.
shots.performance: Exact deterministic glyph completes and neighboring scratches darken slightly; no modeled writing.

camera.endCondition: camera locked for final 10 frames on completed deterministic glyph

shots.environment: No wind; only stable raking light.

shots.purpose: Convert the lamp-out beat into an observable action.
shots.startState: Distant central lamp is small, lit and steady; foreground lamps are soft bokeh.
shots.performance: Central flame sputters twice, shrinks and extinguishes completely.

camera.framing: long-lens lamp row through blurred foreground lamps
camera.focus: pull foreground glow to central distant flame before it dies
camera.endCondition: central wick fully dark; no smoke plume yet

shots.environment: Rain continues beyond the lattice windows; no gust causes the extinction.

shots.purpose: End on residual motion rather than a frozen extinguished lamp.
shots.startState: Central wick is dark with the first thin smoke curl; foreground lamps remain blurred and lit.
shots.performance: Smoke rises, coils once and thins while the distant rain continues; voice-over may begin in edit.

camera.framing: same lamp-row axis as SH17, slightly closer start
camera.focus: hold the first smoke curl, then allow it to soften
camera.endCondition: camera locks for final 8 frames; smoke remains visible but thin

shots.environment: Rain remains the final continuous movement source; no new wind or paper motion.

beforeTechnicalGpuRun: Project Lead reviews the 18-anchor contact sheet
Camera Contract shot order and durations are accepted
SH01 confirms bronze proofreading lamp, not paper lantern
SH15-SH16 deterministic glyph post path is preserved
